title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 4: Moses' warning not to forget Horeb, the ban on carved images and the three cities set apart for the man slayer.

questions.text: According to Deuteronomy 4:2, what must Israel not do with the word Moses commands them?
questions.explanation: Moses tells them not to add to the word he commands, nor take away from it, so that they keep Yahweh's commandments.

answers.text: Read it aloud on the Sabbath day
Add to it or take away from it

questions.text: What happened to the men who followed Baal Peor?
questions.explanation: Moses reminds them that Yahweh destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor, while those who were faithful to Yahweh are all alive today.

answers.text: They were sent back to Egypt
They were forgiven after Moses prayed
They were made to live outside the camp

questions.text: When Yahweh spoke out of the fire at Horeb, what did the people see of him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke out of the middle of the fire. The people heard the voice of words, but saw no form; they only heard a voice.

answers.text: No form at all - they only heard a voice
A man standing in the middle of the fire
A great eagle above the mountain

questions.text: On what did Yahweh write the ten commandments?
questions.explanation: Yahweh declared his covenant, the ten commandments, and wrote them on two stone tablets.

questions.text: In Deuteronomy 4:20, Yahweh brought Israel out of Egypt, which is called what?
questions.explanation: Yahweh took Israel and brought them out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be a people of inheritance to him.

questions.text: What did Yahweh swear concerning Moses because he was angry with him for the people's sakes?
questions.explanation: Yahweh swore that Moses would not go over the Jordan into the good land; Moses must die in this land, while the people go over and possess it.

answers.text: That he would not go over the Jordan into the good land
That he would lead the people across the Jordan
That he would build an altar in the good land
That he would live to see his grandchildren there

questions.text: Complete Deuteronomy 4:24: "For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, ..."
questions.explanation: Moses says: "For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God."

questions.text: If Israel is scattered among the nations, what will the gods they serve there be made of?
questions.explanation: There they would serve gods made by men's hands, of wood and stone, which neither see, hear, eat nor smell.

questions.text: When does Moses say they will find Yahweh after they have been scattered?
questions.explanation: From there they will seek Yahweh their God, and they will find him when they search after him with all their heart and with all their soul.

answers.text: When they search after him with all their heart and soul
When they build him a new altar of stone
When they offer a thousand burnt offerings

questions.text: Which city did Moses set apart for the Gadites, so that a man slayer could flee there?
questions.explanation: Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan: Bezer for the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
